findings.reason: the node dispatched for §22 will look for `probe_has_run` to detect an unprobed wait and find it absent, so the plan must say it was removed and name the surviving carrier (`wait_condition_state`) instead of asserting it remains.
findings.text: §22 states "`declares_a_wait` and `probe_has_run` remain in `reckon/crew/ticker.py`", but `probe_has_run` was deleted by `1eb387165` (`-def probe_has_run(...)` in that commit's diff; `git grep probe_has_run` returns nothing across `reckon/` and `tests/`); only `declares_a_wait` survives, and the fact the marker needs is now carried by the event field `wait_condition_state`, which that deleted helper read

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §22 cites `probe_has_run` as one of two symbols that "remain in `reckon/crew/ticker.py`", but that symbol does not exist in the tree: it was removed by `1eb387165`, the same commit §22 names as having removed `_unprobed_wait` and `UNPROBED_MARKER`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §21's measure drives the in-place reload with one lift standing and feeds the re-arm baseline row, with the negative control "leave the lift groups out of the carried memory; the reload case must then draw new → working"; §22's renders two waiting rows and asserts `waiting?` vs `waiting`, same width, with the negative control "remove the marker; the first case must then fail". Each control fires the guard.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §21's and §22's gate and control logs are recorded "under the run directory", a durable path, not a session scratchpad or node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §21 and §22 name mechanisms (`_lift_groups`, `seed_states`, `STATE_WORD`, `DIM_MARKER`) and carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags into code; the commit shas they cite are evidence pointers, not symbol names.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §21's root cause matches the cited code (lift groups live only in a per-process `RowPolicy`, `path.reseed` rebuilds that policy losing them, and `follow_checkpoint.seed_states` skips the run-id-less lift rows); §22's root cause matches the cited evidence (the marker went with §20's free-text removal, confirmed removed by `1eb387165`). §22's mechanism (draw `waiting?` in the state cell's spare column) can produce its done-when, and the render path it names is the production row cell.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §21 carries one deliverable (lift-group memory surviving the follower's in-place reload and re-arm) and §22 one (the `?` marker for a wait no probe has run for).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — every declared depends-on resolves (s16→s17 present and correct), the new sections' serial order on `reckon/crew/ticker.py` is stated in §21's own text ("the-suite-is-green-at-head §15, then this section, then §16, then §22"), and the plan's recorded position is that the dispatch scope check refuses a second live claim on `ticker.py`, so the graph omits the edge rather than containing a wrong one.
